$comment: SPEC-TOOL-032/R4: Deliberately incomplete until reviewed. Fill project-relative cwd/bin/launcher paths, actual manager name/version, and existing absolute native executables with fixed argument arrays. Probes must actually resolve the manager and query its version, emitting only JSON {path:absolute_resolved_launcher,version:observed_version}. The nested probe must run that lookup through the real representative task runner, including package-script shell behavior where applicable. Printing expected JSON is not evidence. Native runtime plus a reviewed probe script is supported; direct .cmd/.bat records are not. No interpolation or automatic acquisition is provided. Maximum 60 seconds per child: use the existing verify helper for full builds. Review descendant cleanup separately. This template never chooses paths, a manager or a version for you.
